newsitem.title: USA: Intercell names Paul Metzinger CEO.
newsitem.headline: Intercell names Paul Metzinger CEO.

text.p: Intercell Corp said Monday that it appointed Paul Metzinger president and chief executive.
Metzinger replaces Gordon Sales, former chairman, president and chief executive, who resigned from Intercell, the company said.
Theodore Waibel, a director of Intercell, was appointed chairman, the company said.
Metzinger, 58, was also named to the board, the company said.
He has been a securities lawyer in Denver for 27 years and has experience with numerous large and small public companies, Intercell said.
